latest_release.name: v6.6.5 release
latest_release.body:
- Add Dolby Vision profile 5 playback on devices without a Dolby Vision decoder, with GPU color reshaping
- Convert Dolby Vision profile 7 to 8.1 automatically and strip HDR10+ for better compatibility (#1980)
- Fall back to standard HDR decoding when Dolby Vision is unavailable, and warn when colors may be wrong
- Pass Dolby Vision static HDR metadata to the display
- Fix colors of Dolby Vision profile 5 thumbnails
- Improve Dolby Vision decoder selection and stability
- Notify users when hardware video decoding falls back to software
- Keep subtitles on screen in Fit width and portrait Fit/Auto modes when the video overflows the screen thanks @pratikpatel8982)
- Keep PGS/VobSub subtitles clear of the player controls and system bars (thanks @pratikpatel8982)
- Add a vertical position setting for PGS/VobSub subtitles thanks @pratikpatel8982)
- Hide the subtitle style sample when there is no track or the format is unsupported thanks @pratikpatel8982)
- Prefer the file name/path over the embedded metadata title when identifying videos online (#1987)
- Exclude Telegram and other messenger media folders from the library
- Speed up Samba discovery and avoid running it twice at startup
